name: Bank of Nanjing Co., Ltd.
summary: Bank of Nanjing Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of various financial products and services in China. The company offers corporate deposits, savings deposits, foreign currency savings deposits, and certificates of deposit; and personal, corporate, supply chain, and international business loans. It also provides micro financing, private banking, wealth management, cash management, currency investment, foreign exchange, asset management, fund and bond investment, and electronic banking services, as well as credit and debit cards. Bank of Nanjing Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
